call.text: The authors’ architecture uses a two‑stage hierarchical design in which a routing module dynamically draws chunk boundaries and a downsampler selectively retains vectors based on boundary indicators, reducing sequence length while preserving semantically significant positions, and a second stage applies the same dynamic chunking process to the compressed representation to form a nested hierarchy of chunks [HNET:1:c012]. H‑Net (2‑stage) is significantly better than H‑Net (1‑stage) [HNET:3.1:c049].
